answer: A cloned identity starts from zero and must match that sunk cost, while peers cross-check behavioral signatures against an ivory registry of verified lineages and a mirror ledger of stake history. Sybil resistance here relies on proof-of-burn escrow: each agent identity must lock a stake that enters a decaying spiral, released only after sustained legitimate epochs. Fabricating a thousand identities means funding a thousand stakes and forfeiting them on any divergence, making the attack cost scale linearly with the swarm. From once0007's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
